name: slack_post_message
description: This tool allows you to post a message to a Slack channel or direct message conversation as the configured bot user. Use this tool when the user asks to notify, announce, or reply in Slack. Markdown-style mrkdwn formatting is supported including code blocks and mentions. The bot must already be a member of private channels; posting to a private channel it has not joined fails with not_in_channel.

channel.title: Channel reference
channel.description: Reference to a Slack conversation. Provide either the channel id (preferred, stable across renames) or the human-readable channel name.

channel_id.description: The unique conversation id, e.g. C0123456789. Stable across channel renames.

channel_name.description: Human readable channel name without the leading hash sign.

text.description: Message text in Slack mrkdwn. Falls back to plain text where formatting is unsupported.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of a parent message; when provided the message is posted as a threaded reply.

unfurl_links.description: Allow Slack to unfurl URLs in the message.
